q: 儿子___上一年级，作业不多。
zh: 儿子才上一年级，作业不多。
py: ér zi cái shàng yī nián jí zuò yè bù duō
en: My son is only in the first year, so there is not much homework.
why: 才 before a school year means "only", young. 都 wants 了 and says "already", 也 means "also", and 再 means "again".

q: 妈妈一说要去商场，女儿___高兴得跳了起来。
zh: 妈妈一说要去商场，女儿就高兴得跳了起来。
py: mā ma yī shuō yào qù shāng chǎng nǚ ér jiù gāo xìng de tiào le qǐ lái
en: As soon as Mum said they were going to the mall, my daughter jumped for joy.
why: 一说…就 means the reaction came the moment she heard it. 才 means late and 也 means "also", so neither completes 一.

s: 如果明天下雨，我们才不去商场了。
s_py: rú guǒ míng tiān xià yǔ wǒ men cái bù qù shāng chǎng le
zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去商场了。
py: rú guǒ míng tiān xià yǔ wǒ men jiù bù qù shāng chǎng le
en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go to the mall.
why: 如果 pairs with 就. 才 needs 只有 in the first half, so this pairing does not work.

zh: 他昨天晚上十一点才回家。
py: tā zuó tiān wǎn shang shí yī diǎn cái huí jiā
en: He didn't get home until eleven last night.
why: 才 goes after the time phrase and before the verb. It cannot start the sentence or come after 回家; the time phrase may sit before or after the subject.

s: 就我弟弟一个人没来，别人都到了。
s_py: jiù wǒ dì di yī gè rén méi lái bié rén dōu dào le
zh: 就我弟弟一个人没来，别人都到了。
py: jiù wǒ dì di yī gè rén méi lái bié rén dōu dào le
en: Only my younger brother did not come; everyone else is here.
why: Sentence-initial 就 before a person means "only that person", so this is correct, even though 就 before the subject looks odd.

zh: 爸爸一下班就去超市买菜。
py: bà ba yī xià bān jiù qù chāo shì mǎi cài
en: As soon as Dad finishes work he goes to the supermarket to buy food.
why: 一 sits before the first verb and 就 before the second, each right in front of its own verb after the shared subject.

q: 她___三岁，还不会说话。
zh: 她才三岁，还不会说话。
py: tā cái sān suì hái bù huì shuō huà
en: She's only three and can't talk yet.
why: 才 directly before an age means "only", young. 都 and 已经 stress that it is a lot, the opposite of "only", and 也 means "also".

q: 哥哥一到家，___给我打电话。
zh: 哥哥一到家，就给我打电话。
py: gē ge yī dào jiā jiù gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà
en: As soon as my brother gets home he will phone me.
why: 一到家…就 means the call comes immediately after arriving. 才 means late and contradicts 一.

zh: 作业写完了你才能看电视。
py: zuò yè xiě wán le nǐ cái néng kàn diàn shì
en: You can watch TV only after your homework is done.
why: 才 follows the subject 你 and comes before the modal 能. Putting 才 in front of 你 is the English "then you" order and is wrong.

q: 你问我家在哪儿？这儿___是我家。
zh: 你问我家在哪儿？这儿就是我家。
py: nǐ wèn wǒ jiā zài nǎ r zhè r jiù shì wǒ jiā
en: You ask where my home is? This right here is my home.
why: 就 before 是 pins down "right here". 也 would mean "this is also my home", not an answer to where it is.

q: 我现在___给你转钱，你看一下手机。
zh: 我现在就给你转钱，你看一下手机。
py: wǒ xiàn zài jiù gěi nǐ zhuǎn qián nǐ kàn yī xià shǒu jī
en: I'll transfer you the money right now, so check your phone.
why: 现在 plus 就 means "right now". 再 would postpone the transfer, which clashes with 现在 and with checking the phone.

s: 这条裤子才八十块，我就买了两条。
s_py: zhè tiáo kù zi cái bā shí kuài wǒ jiù mǎi le liǎng tiáo
zh: 这条裤子才八十块，我就买了两条。
py: zhè tiáo kù zi cái bā shí kuài wǒ jiù mǎi le liǎng tiáo
en: These trousers are only eighty kuai, so I bought two pairs.
why: 才 before the price means "only", and 就买了 shows the quick decision that followed. Both are correct here.

q: 超市很近，走路五分钟___到了。
zh: 超市很近，走路五分钟就到了。
py: chāo shì hěn jìn zǒu lù wǔ fēn zhōng jiù dào le
en: The supermarket is close; it's only a five-minute walk.
why: Close plus five minutes means quick and easy: 就, with 了 at the end. 才 would say the walk took a long time, which contradicts 很近.

q: 电视剧八点开始，女儿六点___坐在沙发上等了。
zh: 电视剧八点开始，女儿六点就坐在沙发上等了。
py: diàn shì jù bā diǎn kāi shǐ nǚ ér liù diǎn jiù zuò zài shā fā shàng děng le
en: The drama starts at eight, but my daughter was already sitting on the sofa waiting at six.
why: Six is two hours before the start, so she was early: 就. 才 means late and cannot describe a time before the start.

q: 妈妈今天早上六点就起床___，给我们做早饭。
zh: 妈妈今天早上六点就起床了，给我们做早饭。
py: mā ma jīn tiān zǎo shang liù diǎn jiù qǐ chuáng le gěi wǒ men zuò zǎo fàn
en: Mum got up as early as six this morning to make us breakfast.
why: Getting up this morning is one finished event, so 就 takes 了. 着 and 过 cannot mark a completed action in a story like this.

q: 这个商店___卖水果，别的东西都没有。
zh: 这个商店就卖水果，别的东西都没有。
py: zhè ge shāng diàn jiù mài shuǐ guǒ bié de dōng xi dōu méi yǒu
en: This shop only sells fruit; it has nothing else.
why: 就 before 卖 means "only sells". 还 and 也 mean "also", which the next clause (nothing else) rules out.

zh: 洗手间就在厨房旁边。
py: xǐ shǒu jiān jiù zài chú fáng páng biān
en: The bathroom is right next to the kitchen.
why: 就 is an adverb and goes before 在. It cannot come between 在 and the place.

q: 只有存够了钱，我们___能买房子。
zh: 只有存够了钱，我们才能买房子。
py: zhǐ yǒu cún gòu le qián wǒ men cái néng mǎi fáng zi
en: Only when we have saved enough money can we buy a house.
why: 只有 states the one required condition and takes 才, usually followed by 能. 就 pairs with 只要 or 如果.

s: 我马上才来，你等一下。
s_py: wǒ mǎ shàng cái lái nǐ děng yī xià
zh: 我马上就来，你等一下。
py: wǒ mǎ shàng jiù lái nǐ děng yī xià
en: I'll be right there, wait a moment.
why: 马上 means "right away" and pairs with 就. 才 means late, which contradicts 马上.

q: 这条裙子很便宜，妈妈看了一眼___买了。
zh: 这条裙子很便宜，妈妈看了一眼就买了。
py: zhè tiáo qún zi hěn pián yi mā ma kàn le yī yǎn jiù mǎi le
en: The skirt was cheap, and Mum bought it after just one look.
why: One glance and a purchase is little effort, so 就 (which also goes with the final 了). 才 would mean she needed a lot of effort first.

q: 只要你不乱花钱，每个月___能存下一千块。
zh: 只要你不乱花钱，每个月就能存下一千块。
py: zhǐ yào nǐ bù luàn huā qián měi gè yuè jiù néng cún xià yī qiān kuài
en: As long as you don't spend wildly, you can save a thousand kuai a month.
why: 只要 means the condition is enough, so the result takes 就. 才 would need 只有 in the first half.

q: 现在___七点，你再睡一会儿吧。
zh: 现在才七点，你再睡一会儿吧。
py: xiàn zài cái qī diǎn nǐ zài shuì yī huì r ba
en: It's only seven o'clock now, so sleep a little longer.
why: 才 before a clock time means "only", still early, which supports sleeping longer. 都 and 已经 would say it is already late and would need 了.

q: 你找李老师吗？我___是。
zh: 你找李老师吗？我就是。
py: nǐ zhǎo lǐ lǎo shī ma wǒ jiù shì
en: Are you looking for Teacher Li? That is me.
why: 就 before 是 means "precisely", so "I am the one". 也 would mean "me too", which does not answer the question.

q: 姐姐二十岁就结婚___，现在孩子都上学了。
zh: 姐姐二十岁就结婚了，现在孩子都上学了。
py: jiě jie èr shí suì jiù jié hūn le xiàn zài hái zi dōu shàng xué le
en: My sister got married at twenty, and now her child is already at school.
why: Getting married at twenty is a completed event, so 就 takes 了. 着 gives a continuing state, and 的 would need 是 in front to work.

q: 儿子一回家___要吃饭。
zh: 儿子一回家就要吃饭。
py: ér zi yī huí jiā jiù yào chī fàn
en: As soon as my son gets home he wants to eat.
why: 一…就 means the second action follows right after the first. 才 means late and 也 means "also", so neither completes 一.

q: 只有多看书，___能学好中文。
zh: 只有多看书，才能学好中文。
py: zhǐ yǒu duō kàn shū cái néng xué hǎo zhōng wén
en: Only by reading a lot can you learn Chinese well.
why: 只有 names the one necessary condition and pairs with 才. 就 pairs with 只要 or 如果, not 只有.

q: 他们存了整整五年钱，___买得起一套小房子。
zh: 他们存了整整五年钱，才买得起一套小房子。
py: tā men cún le zhěng zhěng wǔ nián qián cái mǎi de qǐ yī tào xiǎo fáng zi
en: They saved for five whole years before they could afford a small flat.
why: Five whole years is a long haul, so the result is hard-won: 才. 就 would make five years sound short, which 整整 rules out.

q: 她五岁___会游泳了，真厉害。
zh: 她五岁就会游泳了，真厉害。
py: tā wǔ suì jiù huì yóu yǒng le zhēn lì hài
en: She could already swim at five, which is impressive.
why: The number comes before the adverb and 厉害 praises her, so five is early: 就, with 了. 才 would mean not until five and cannot take this 了.

q: 我钱包里___有十块钱，不够买这个。
zh: 我钱包里就有十块钱，不够买这个。
py: wǒ qián bāo lǐ jiù yǒu shí kuài qián bù gòu mǎi zhè ge
en: I only have ten kuai in my wallet, which isn't enough to buy this.
why: 就 before 有 plus a small amount means "only". 也 means "also", 还 means "still" and 再 means "again", none of which explain not having enough.

q: ___孩子写完作业，他___能看电视，这是我们家的规矩。
zh: 只有孩子写完作业，他才能看电视，这是我们家的规矩。
py: zhǐ yǒu hái zi xiě wán zuò yè tā cái néng kàn diàn shì zhè shì wǒ men jiā de guī ju
en: The child can only watch TV once his homework is done; that is our house rule.
why: The house rule is "only after homework", so 只有…才. 只要…就 would make the condition easy, and the other two pairings are mismatched.

s: 只有打折的时候，姐姐才买衣服。
s_py: zhǐ yǒu dǎ zhé de shí hou jiě jie cái mǎi yī fu
zh: 只有打折的时候，姐姐才买衣服。
py: zhǐ yǒu dǎ zhé de shí hou jiě jie cái mǎi yī fu
en: My sister buys clothes only when they are on sale.
why: 只有…才 is the right pair for a single necessary condition, and 才 follows the subject 姐姐.

q: 哥哥很能干，一个晚上___把房间整理好了。
zh: 哥哥很能干，一个晚上就把房间整理好了。
py: gē ge hěn néng gàn yī gè wǎn shang jiù bǎ fáng jiān zhěng lǐ hǎo le
en: My brother is capable; he tidied the whole room in a single evening.
why: Being capable makes one evening count as quick: 就, with 了. 才 would mean it took too long, which clashes with 很能干.

s: 他五岁才会说话，妈妈那时很着急。
s_py: tā wǔ suì cái huì shuō huà mā ma nà shí hěn zháo jí
zh: 他五岁才会说话，妈妈那时很着急。
py: tā wǔ suì cái huì shuō huà mā ma nà shí hěn zháo jí
en: He didn't talk until he was five, and Mum was very worried then.
why: A number before 才 means "not until", and no 了 is needed. This is correct and fits Mum being worried.

q: 妹妹一看见妈妈___哭了。
zh: 妹妹一看见妈妈就哭了。
py: mèi mei yī kàn jiàn mā ma jiù kū le
en: As soon as my sister saw Mum, she burst into tears.
why: 一看见…就哭了 means she cried the moment she saw her. 才 would mean late, the opposite of 一.

q: 她昨天十点___到家___，我们等了她很久。
zh: 她昨天十点才到家，我们等了她很久。
py: tā zuó tiān shí diǎn cái dào jiā wǒ men děng le tā hěn jiǔ
en: She did not get home until ten yesterday; we waited for her for ages.
why: Waiting ages means ten was late: 才, and 才 meaning "not until" takes no 了. 就 with 了 would make ten sound early, against 等了很久.

q: 要是你喜欢，我___给你买。
zh: 要是你喜欢，我就给你买。
py: yào shì nǐ xǐ huan wǒ jiù gěi nǐ mǎi
en: If you like it, I'll buy it for you.
why: 要是 means "if", and the result takes 就. 才 would need 只有 in the first half.

zh: 爷爷今天早上五点就出门了。
py: yé ye jīn tiān zǎo shang wǔ diǎn jiù chū mén le
en: Grandpa went out as early as five this morning.
why: Five is early, so 就 follows the time and precedes the verb, with 了 at the end. 就 cannot come before the time or after 出门.

q: 奶奶做饭很快，半个小时___做好了四个菜。
zh: 奶奶做饭很快，半个小时就做好了四个菜。
py: nǎi nai zuò fàn hěn kuài bàn gè xiǎo shí jiù zuò hǎo le sì gè cài
en: Grandma cooks fast; she had four dishes ready in just half an hour.
why: Fast cooking makes half an hour short, so 就, with 了 after 做好. 才 would call it slow, against 很快.

q: 女儿三岁就认识很多字___。
zh: 女儿三岁就认识很多字了。
py: nǚ ér sān suì jiù rèn shi hěn duō zì le
en: My daughter already knew lots of characters at three.
why: 就 with an early age marks an achieved state, and 了 closes it. 着 and 过 cannot say the state has been reached.

src_py: nǐ xǐ huan wǒ gěi nǐ mǎi
task: Rewrite with 只要 (as long as ...).
zh: 只要你喜欢我就给你买。
py: zhǐ yào nǐ xǐ huan wǒ jiù gěi nǐ mǎi
en: As long as you like it, I'll buy it for you.
why: 只要 opens the condition and the result takes 就 before its verb. 才 would need 只有 instead.

q: 银行___在超市旁边，很好找。
zh: 银行就在超市旁边，很好找。
py: yín háng jiù zài chāo shì páng biān hěn hǎo zhǎo
en: The bank is right next to the supermarket, so it's easy to find.
why: 就 before 在 means "right there", which is why it is easy to find. 也 would mean the bank is also next to the supermarket.

q: 这台电视机___两千块，太便宜了，我们买吧。
zh: 这台电视机才两千块，太便宜了，我们买吧。
py: zhè tái diàn shì jī cái liǎng qiān kuài tài pián yi le wǒ men mǎi ba
en: This TV is only two thousand kuai, so cheap, let's buy it.
why: 才 before a price means "only that much", which fits 太便宜了. 都 would make the price sound like a lot.

q: 他三岁___会说话，妈妈那时很着急。
zh: 他三岁才会说话，妈妈那时很着急。
py: tā sān suì cái huì shuō huà mā ma nà shí hěn zháo jí
en: He didn't talk until he was three, and Mum was very worried then.
why: The number comes before the adverb, so the pattern is "not until three": 才. 就 would mean he talked as early as three, but then Mum would not be worried.

q: 你等我一下，我马上___来。
zh: 你等我一下，我马上就来。
py: nǐ děng wǒ yī xià wǒ mǎ shàng jiù lái
en: Wait a moment, I'll be right there.
why: 马上 plus 就 means "right away". 再 would mean "come again", which does not fit an immediate arrival.

zh: 妹妹才三岁。
py: mèi mei cái sān suì
en: My younger sister is only three.
why: 才 goes directly before the age to mean "only". With the age first the meaning would become "not until three".

q: 我才学___两个月中文，说得不太好。
zh: 我才学了两个月中文，说得不太好。
py: wǒ cái xué le liǎng gè yuè zhōng wén shuō de bù tài hǎo
en: I've only studied Chinese for two months, so I don't speak it very well.
why: 才 plus a length of time means "only", and the verb can still take 了 for the finished stretch. 着 and 过 cannot mark a completed stretch of study.

s: 只有多存钱，就能买房子。
s_py: zhǐ yǒu duō cún qián jiù néng mǎi fáng zi
zh: 只有多存钱，才能买房子。
py: zhǐ yǒu duō cún qián cái néng mǎi fáng zi
en: Only by saving a lot can you buy a house.
why: 只有 pairs with 才, never with 就. 就 belongs with 只要 and 如果.

q: 我___去过一次那家商场，不太熟。
zh: 我就去过一次那家商场，不太熟。
py: wǒ jiù qù guò yī cì nà jiā shāng chǎng bù tài shú
en: I've only been to that mall once, so I don't know it well.
why: 就 before a verb with a small amount means "only once". 还 would mean "also been", which does not explain not knowing it.

q: 客人七点才到，可是妈妈四点就开始做饭___。
zh: 客人七点才到，可是妈妈四点就开始做饭了。
py: kè rén qī diǎn cái dào kě shì mā ma sì diǎn jiù kāi shǐ zuò fàn le
en: The guests only arrived at seven, but Mum had started cooking at four.
why: The contrast is 才 with no 了 (late) against 就 with 了 (early). 着 and 过 cannot mark that cooking began.

s: 哥哥昨天早上七点出门就了。
s_py: gē ge zuó tiān zǎo shang qī diǎn chū mén jiù le
zh: 哥哥昨天早上七点就出门了。
py: gē ge zuó tiān zǎo shang qī diǎn jiù chū mén le
en: My brother went out as early as seven yesterday morning.
why: 就 is placed before the verb, not after it. Only 了 goes at the end.

s: 只有你同意，才我告诉你。
s_py: zhǐ yǒu nǐ tóng yì cái wǒ gào su nǐ
zh: 只有你同意，我才告诉你。
py: zhǐ yǒu nǐ tóng yì wǒ cái gào su nǐ
en: I will tell you only if you agree.
why: 才 goes after the subject 我 and before the verb. It cannot open the clause the way English "then" does.

s: 电视剧八点开始，女儿六点就坐在沙发上了。
s_py: diàn shì jù bā diǎn kāi shǐ nǚ ér liù diǎn jiù zuò zài shā fā shàng le
zh: 电视剧八点开始，女儿六点就坐在沙发上了。
py: diàn shì jù bā diǎn kāi shǐ nǚ ér liù diǎn jiù zuò zài shā fā shàng le
en: The drama starts at eight, but my daughter was already on the sofa at six.
why: Six is well before the start, so 就, and one finished event takes 了. The sentence is correct.

s: 这家店卖就水果。
s_py: zhè jiā diàn mài jiù shuǐ guǒ
zh: 这家店就卖水果。
py: zhè jiā diàn jiù mài shuǐ guǒ
en: This shop only sells fruit.
why: 就 meaning "only" must come before the verb 卖. After the verb it is not a possible sentence.

q: ___妈妈同意，爸爸___不会反对。
zh: 只要妈妈同意，爸爸就不会反对。
py: zhǐ yào mā ma tóng yì bà ba jiù bù huì fǎn duì
en: As long as Mum agrees, Dad won't object.
why: "As long as" is 只要…就. 只有…才 means "only if", a different meaning, and 只要…才 and 只有…就 are mismatched pairs.

q: 如果你不想自己做饭，我们___叫外卖吧。
zh: 如果你不想自己做饭，我们就叫外卖吧。
py: rú guǒ nǐ bù xiǎng zì jǐ zuò fàn wǒ men jiù jiào wài mài ba
en: If you don't feel like cooking, let's order takeaway.
why: 如果 introduces the condition and the suggestion takes 就. 才 needs 只有, and 又 means "again".

q: 爸爸找了半天___找到钥匙。
zh: 爸爸找了半天才找到钥匙。
py: bà ba zhǎo le bàn tiān cái zhǎo dào yào shi
en: Dad searched for ages before he found the keys.
why: Searching for ages means the result came late and with effort: 才, with no 了. 就 would say he found them at once, which clashes with 半天.

q: 弟弟昨天晚上十一点___睡，今天起不来。
zh: 弟弟昨天晚上十一点才睡，今天起不来。
py: dì di zuó tiān wǎn shang shí yī diǎn cái shuì jīn tiān qǐ bù lái
en: My younger brother didn't go to bed until eleven last night, so he can't get up today.
why: He cannot get up, so eleven was late for bedtime: 才. 就 would make eleven sound early and clash with the second clause.

q: 我们小区那么多人，___隔壁的张奶奶会说英语。
zh: 我们小区那么多人，就隔壁的张奶奶会说英语。
py: wǒ men xiǎo qū nà me duō rén jiù gé bì de zhāng nǎi nai huì shuō yīng yǔ
en: Among all the people in our complex, only Grandma Zhang next door speaks English.
why: 就 before the person singles out one from many. 都 and 也 cannot mean "only" and would not suit 那么多人.

s: 他一看价钱，就把衣服放下了。
s_py: tā yī kàn jià qián jiù bǎ yī fu fàng xià le
zh: 他一看价钱，就把衣服放下了。
py: tā yī kàn jià qián jiù bǎ yī fu fàng xià le
en: As soon as he saw the price, he put the clothes back.
why: 一…就 for one finished event takes 了 at the end, and 就 sits before 把. It is correct.

s: 这本书五块钱才，真便宜。
s_py: zhè běn shū wǔ kuài qián cái zhēn pián yi
zh: 这本书才五块钱，真便宜。
py: zhè běn shū cái wǔ kuài qián zhēn pián yi
en: This book is only five kuai, how cheap!
why: 才 meaning "only" goes before the number, not after it. Nothing can follow the price this way.

q: 我们家___爸爸会做饭。
zh: 我们家就爸爸会做饭。
py: wǒ men jiā jiù bà ba huì zuò fàn
en: In our family only Dad can cook.
why: 就 before a person means "only that person". 也, 还 and 都 cannot be put before 爸爸 to mean "only".

q: 这个菜很好做，我看一遍___会了。
zh: 这个菜很好做，我看一遍就会了。
py: zhè ge cài hěn hǎo zuò wǒ kàn yī biàn jiù huì le
en: This dish is easy to make; I had learned it after watching just once.
why: Easy dish plus one viewing is little effort, so 就, with 了 after 会. 才 would mean it took many tries.

s: 你不买，我就不买。
s_py: nǐ bù mǎi wǒ jiù bù mǎi
zh: 你不买，我就不买。
py: nǐ bù mǎi wǒ jiù bù mǎi
en: If you don't buy it, I won't either.
why: 就 sits after the subject 我 and before 不买, exactly where it belongs.

s: 我才买了一件，别的还没看呢。
s_py: wǒ cái mǎi le yī jiàn bié de hái méi kàn ne
zh: 我才买了一件，别的还没看呢。
py: wǒ cái mǎi le yī jiàn bié de hái méi kàn ne
en: I've only bought one so far; I haven't looked at the rest yet.
why: 才 plus a counted amount means "only", and 了 after the verb is fine. The "no 了 with 才" rule applies to "not until", not to this.

task: Say that he did not get home until ten (it was late).
zh: 他十点才到家。
py: tā shí diǎn cái dào jiā
en: He didn't get home until ten.
why: Late means 才 after the time and before the verb, with no 了. 就 would make ten sound early.

s: 哥哥一下班才给我打电话。
s_py: gē ge yī xià bān cái gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà
zh: 哥哥一下班就给我打电话。
py: gē ge yī xià bān jiù gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà
en: As soon as my brother gets off work, he phones me.
why: 一…就 means the second action follows at once. 才 means late and cannot complete 一.

q: 洗手间___在那边，你看见了吗？
zh: 洗手间就在那边，你看见了吗？
py: xǐ shǒu jiān jiù zài nà biān nǐ kàn jiàn le ma
en: The toilet is right over there, can you see it?
why: 就 before 在 means "right there", pointing it out. 也 means "also" and 再 means "again", neither of which points anything out.

q: 我昨天九点就睡___。
zh: 我昨天九点就睡了。
py: wǒ zuó tiān jiǔ diǎn jiù shuì le
en: I went to bed as early as nine yesterday.
why: One finished event with 就 needs 了 at the end. 着 would describe a continuing state and 过 a past experience, neither of which is a single bedtime yesterday.

q: 他昨天八点___来___，太早了，我还没起床。
zh: 他昨天八点就来了，太早了，我还没起床。
py: tā zuó tiān bā diǎn jiù lái le tài zǎo le wǒ hái méi qǐ chuáng
en: He came as early as eight yesterday, so early that I was still in bed.
why: 太早了 makes eight early, so 就, and a single event yesterday needs 了. 才 means late, and 就 without 了 sounds like a plan or habit, not yesterday.

q: 如果明天下雨，我们___不去商场了。
zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去商场了。
py: rú guǒ míng tiān xià yǔ wǒ men jiù bù qù shāng chǎng le
en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go to the mall.
why: 如果 introduces a condition and the result takes 就. 才 needs 只有 in the first half, and there is none here.

q: 这本书___五块钱，真便宜。
zh: 这本书才五块钱，真便宜。
py: zhè běn shū cái wǔ kuài qián zhēn pián yi
en: This book is only five kuai, how cheap!
why: 才 before a price means "only that much". 都 and 也 do not mean "only", and 又 means "again", so none fit a cheap price.

q: 我问了三次，儿子___告诉我他的成绩。
zh: 我问了三次，儿子才告诉我他的成绩。
py: wǒ wèn le sān cì ér zi cái gào su wǒ tā de chéng jì
en: I asked three times before my son told me his results.
why: Asking three times shows it was hard to get the answer: 才. 就 would mean he answered at once, which clashes with 三次.

q: 哥哥十点___回来___，妈妈等得都睡着了。
zh: 哥哥十点才回来，妈妈等得都睡着了。
py: gē ge shí diǎn cái huí lái mā ma děng de dōu shuì zháo le
en: My brother did not get back until ten, and Mum waited so long that she fell asleep.
why: Mum falling asleep waiting means ten was late: 才, with no 了. 就 plus 了 would make ten early, against the second clause.

q: 这个玩具太简单了，女儿玩一会儿___不玩了。
zh: 这个玩具太简单了，女儿玩一会儿就不玩了。
py: zhè ge wán jù tài jiǎn dān le nǚ ér wán yī huì r jiù bù wán le
en: This toy is too easy; my daughter stopped playing with it after a little while.
why: 太简单 means she tired of it quickly, so a short time already leads to the result: 就. 才 would mean she played for a long time first.

s: 你不去，我不就去。
s_py: nǐ bù qù wǒ bù jiù qù
zh: 你不去，我就不去。
py: nǐ bù qù wǒ jiù bù qù
en: If you don't go, I won't go.
why: 就 goes before 不 and the verb: 就不去. 不就去 is not possible.

q: 只有周末，爸爸___有时间陪孩子。
zh: 只有周末，爸爸才有时间陪孩子。
py: zhǐ yǒu zhōu mò bà ba cái yǒu shí jiān péi hái zi
en: Only at weekends does Dad have time to spend with the children.
why: 只有周末 is the only time that works, so 才. 就 would belong with 只要 or 如果.

q: 商场正在打折，我们去晚了，下午三点___到，好东西都卖完了。
zh: 商场正在打折，我们去晚了，下午三点才到，好东西都卖完了。
py: shāng chǎng zhèng zài dǎ zhé wǒ men qù wǎn le xià wǔ sān diǎn cái dào hǎo dōng xi dōu mài wán le
en: The mall had a sale, but we were late; we only got there at three and the good things were sold out.
why: Going late and finding things sold out makes three o'clock late: 才, with no 了. 就 would make three sound early, against 卖完了.

s: 一爸爸回家，就我们吃饭。
s_py: yī bà ba huí jiā jiù wǒ men chī fàn
zh: 爸爸一回家，我们就吃饭。
py: bà ba yī huí jiā wǒ men jiù chī fàn
en: As soon as Dad gets home, we eat.
why: 一 goes before the verb, after the subject, never before the subject. 就 also goes after 我们, not before it.

q: 爸爸一喝酒，脸___红。
zh: 爸爸一喝酒，脸就红。
py: bà ba yī hē jiǔ liǎn jiù hóng
en: Dad goes red in the face whenever he drinks.
why: 一喝酒…就 states a habit, with no 了. 才 and 还 do not pair with 一.

s: 银行在就超市旁边。
s_py: yín háng zài jiù chāo shì páng biān
zh: 银行就在超市旁边。
py: yín háng jiù zài chāo shì páng biān
en: The bank is right next to the supermarket.
why: 就 is an adverb and must come before 在. Putting it between 在 and the place is not possible in Chinese.

q: 我一买东西，钱___花完了。
zh: 我一买东西，钱就花完了。
py: wǒ yī mǎi dōng xi qián jiù huā wán le
en: Whenever I go shopping the money is gone in no time.
why: 一…就 links two events that follow immediately, so the money is spent as soon as I shop. 才 means slow and cannot pair with 一.

zh: 只要价钱合适我就买。
py: zhǐ yào jià qián hé shì wǒ jiù mǎi
en: As long as the price is right, I'll buy it.
why: 只要 opens the condition and 就 sits right before the result verb. 就 cannot come before the subject 我.

q: 只要价钱合适，我___买。
zh: 只要价钱合适，我就买。
py: zhǐ yào jià qián hé shì wǒ jiù mǎi
en: As long as the price is right, I'll buy it.
why: 只要 says the condition is enough, and the result takes 就. 才 belongs with 只有 and would make the condition sound hard to meet.

q: 我打了五次电话，姐姐___接。
zh: 我打了五次电话，姐姐才接。
py: wǒ dǎ le wǔ cì diàn huà jiě jie cái jiē
en: I rang five times before my sister picked up.
why: Needing five calls means it took effort: 才. 就 would mean she picked up straight away, which contradicts five calls.

s: 只要价钱便宜，我才买。
s_py: zhǐ yào jià qián pián yi wǒ cái mǎi
zh: 只要价钱便宜，我就买。
py: zhǐ yào jià qián pián yi wǒ jiù mǎi
en: As long as the price is cheap, I'll buy it.
why: 只要 pairs with 就. 才 belongs with 只有, so 只要…才 is a mismatched pair.

src: 我们等了一个小时，他来了。
src_py: wǒ men děng le yī gè xiǎo shí tā lái le
task: Say that he only came after we had waited an hour (use 才).
zh: 我们等了一个小时他才来。
py: wǒ men děng le yī gè xiǎo shí tā cái lái
en: We waited an hour before he finally came.
why: After an hour of waiting, his arrival is late: 才 goes after the second subject 他 and before 来, with no 了.

zh: 如果明天下雨我们就不去商场了。
py: rú guǒ míng tiān xià yǔ wǒ men jiù bù qù shāng chǎng le
en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go to the mall.
why: 就 sits after the second-clause subject 我们, right before the verb. Putting 就 before 我们 would turn it into "only we".

q: 爸爸五点就下班___，还给我们买了蛋糕。
zh: 爸爸五点就下班了，还给我们买了蛋糕。
py: bà ba wǔ diǎn jiù xià bān le hái gěi wǒ men mǎi le dàn gāo
en: Dad finished work at five and even bought us a cake.
why: Leaving work at five is a finished event, so 就 takes 了. 过 would say he has done it at some time before, and 着 would describe a continuing state.

q: 我___想买一件外套，不想买别的。
zh: 我就想买一件外套，不想买别的。
py: wǒ jiù xiǎng mǎi yī jiàn wài tào bù xiǎng mǎi bié de
en: I only want to buy a coat and nothing else.
why: 就 before 想买一件 means "only one", matching "nothing else". 还 and 也 mean "also want", the opposite.

zh: 我钱包里就有十块钱。
py: wǒ qián bāo lǐ jiù yǒu shí kuài qián
en: I only have ten kuai in my wallet.
why: 就 goes right before 有 and the small amount to mean "only". Elsewhere it would not limit the amount.

src_py: nǚ ér huí dào jiā xiān xiě zuò yè
task: Say it with 一…就: as soon as she gets home, she does her homework first.
zh: 女儿一回到家就先写作业。
py: nǚ ér yī huí dào jiā jiù xiān xiě zuò yè
en: As soon as my daughter gets home she does her homework first.
why: 一 goes before 回到家 and 就 before 先写作业, each in front of its own verb. 才 would break the idea of "immediately".

q: 你要找的人___是他，那个穿蓝衣服的。
zh: 你要找的人就是他，那个穿蓝衣服的。
py: nǐ yào zhǎo de rén jiù shì tā nà ge chuān lán yī fu de
en: The person you're looking for is that man in blue.
why: 就 before 是 means "it is precisely him", which identifies the person. 也 would say he too is a person you are looking for.

zh: 我们家就爸爸会修电脑。
py: wǒ men jiā jiù bà ba huì xiū diàn nǎo
en: In our family only Dad can fix computers.
why: 就 meaning "only" goes right before the person it limits, 爸爸. After 会 it would no longer single out Dad.

q: 我一收到工资，___把钱存起来。
zh: 我一收到工资，就把钱存起来。
py: wǒ yī shōu dào gōng zī jiù bǎ qián cún qǐ lái
en: As soon as I get paid, I put the money in the bank.
why: 一收到…就 means the second action follows at once. 才 would mean late, the opposite idea.

q: 哥哥十八岁就上大学___，比同学早两年。
zh: 哥哥十八岁就上大学了，比同学早两年。
py: gē ge shí bā suì jiù shàng dà xué le bǐ tóng xué zǎo liǎng nián
en: My brother started university at eighteen, two years earlier than his classmates.
why: Starting university early is a finished fact, so 就 takes 了. 着 cannot mark the start, and 的 would need 是 earlier in the sentence.

q: 商店九点开门，妈妈八点半___到了。
zh: 商店九点开门，妈妈八点半就到了。
py: shāng diàn jiǔ diǎn kāi mén mā ma bā diǎn bàn jiù dào le
en: The shop opens at nine, and Mum was already there by half past eight.
why: Half past eight is before the shop even opens, so the speaker feels it is early: 就, with 了 at the end. 才 would mean late and cannot sit with this 了.

q: 全家人都去了，___妈妈没去。
zh: 全家人都去了，就妈妈没去。
py: quán jiā rén dōu qù le jiù mā ma méi qù
en: Everyone in the family went; only Mum did not.
why: 就 before 妈妈 means "only Mum". 也 would say Mum also did not go, which contradicts everyone going.

q: 我们在这个小区才住___半年，邻居还不太熟。
zh: 我们在这个小区才住了半年，邻居还不太熟。
py: wǒ men zài zhè ge xiǎo qū cái zhù le bàn nián lín jū hái bù tài shú
en: We've only lived in this neighbourhood for half a year, so we don't know the neighbours well yet.
why: 才 plus a length of time means "only", and the verb takes 了 for the finished stretch. 着 means a continuing state and 过 means a past experience, so neither fits.

q: 弟弟早上十点才起床，哥哥七点就出去跑步___。
zh: 弟弟早上十点才起床，哥哥七点就出去跑步了。
py: dì di zǎo shang shí diǎn cái qǐ chuáng gē ge qī diǎn jiù chū qù pǎo bù le
en: My younger brother only got up at ten, but my older brother had already gone running at seven.
why: 才起床 has no 了 while 就出去跑步 needs one, which is exactly the contrast. 着 and 过 cannot say the run has already happened.

src_py: jiě jie liù diǎn chī fàn
task: Say that my sister had eaten as early as six (it was early).
zh: 姐姐六点就吃饭了。
py: jiě jie liù diǎn jiù chī fàn le
en: My sister had eaten by six already.
why: Early means 就 after the time and before the verb, and one finished event takes 了. 才 would mean late and cannot take 了.
